import ctypes

def load_gsl_libraries():
    """Load GSL libraries in the correct order."""
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    return gsl

def get_default_robust_type(gsl):
    """Retrieve the default robust fitting type and its tuning constant."""
    # Define the structure for gsl_multifit_robust_type
    class GSLMultifitRobustType(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [
            ("name", ctypes.c_char_p),
            ("weight", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("dpsi", ctypes.c_void_p),
            ("tuning", ctypes.c_double)
        ]

    # Ensure the symbol exists in the library
    if not hasattr(gsl, "gsl_multifit_robust_default"):
        raise AttributeError("gsl_multifit_robust_default symbol not found in the GSL library.")

    # Get the pointer to gsl_multifit_robust_default
    gsl_multifit_robust_default = ctypes.POINTER(GSLMultifitRobustType).in_dll(gsl, "gsl_multifit_robust_default")

    # Extract the name and tuning constant
    name_ptr = gsl_multifit_robust_default.contents.name
    name = ctypes.string_at(name_ptr).decode("ascii", errors="ignore")
    tuning = gsl_multifit_robust_default.contents.tuning

    return name, tuning

def assert_test():
    """Run assertion tests to validate correctness."""
    gsl = load_gsl_libraries()
    result = get_default_robust_type(gsl)

    # Validate the output
    assert isinstance(result, tuple), "Output must be a tuple."
    assert len(result) == 2, "Output tuple must have two elements."
    assert abs(result[1] - 4.685) < 1e-6, "Tuning constant must be approximately 4.685."

    # Allow flexibility in the name comparison to avoid case sensitivity issues
    assert result[0].strip().lower() == "bisquare", "Name must be 'bisquare'."

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
